claims: Meissen is a Saxon town near Dresden.
As of 2023, the population of Meissen is approximately 29,051.
The Meissen Porcelain Manufactory was established in 1710 by Augustus the Strong.
The Meissen Porcelain Manufactory was the first European factory to produce true hard-paste porcelain.
The Crossed Swords mark was established in 1720 to protect its unique porcelain designs.
Meissen has over 1,000 years of history.
Albrechtsburg Castle was the former seat of the Wettin dynasty.
Albrechtsburg Castle is Germany's first castle built as a residence rather than a fortress.
Meissen Cathedral is a Gothic landmark adjacent to Albrechtsburg Castle.
The Church of Our Lady houses a unique porcelain carillon.
Meissen is situated on the Saxon Wine Route along the Elbe River.
Meissen was founded as a margraviate by Henry the Fowler in the 10th century.
Augustus the Strong founded the porcelain factory in Meissen in 1710, breaking the Asian monopoly on porcelain production.
